Name: Eliab, Son of Helon
Summary: Eliab, son of Helon, was the prince of the tribe of Zebulun at the census in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Eliab led Zebulun's 57,400 men and brought the tribe's offering for the dedication of the altar.
LifeLesson: A name shared with others still belongs to one man's own calling.
